name: agy-discipline
description: Personal cost-discipline rules for Antigravity (agy) delegation: session pre-flight, short abort leash, session cost-awareness, config-first enforcement. Complements antigravity-for-claude-code; does not replace it.

enabled.title: Inject discipline rules at session start
enabled.description: When on, a SessionStart hook injects these personal delegation-discipline rules as session context. Set to off/false/0/no to suppress.
